clips.title: The story
paras: Break a Few Eggs is an errand assisting a harried cook who must keep up with endless meal preparations. Securing fresh, fragile ingredients without breaking them keeps the kitchen running and the cooking on schedule.

Feeding a crowd is an exhausting, never-ending endeavor. Between breakfast, lunch, and dinner, there is scarcely any time to step away from the stove, let alone leave the kitchen to scrounge for raw provisions. In Break a Few Eggs, a hard-pressed cook turns to passing adventurers to secure fresh eggs before the next meal service falls behind.

Transporting eggs requires a gentle touch that brute force cannot replace. The cook may offer sharp words and little praise, but intact ingredients speak for themselves. Once the eggs are delivered safe and unbroken, the cook wastes no time sending the gatherer off and returning straight to work over the fire.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bah! I almost forgot I need to get breakfast ready.
Friend, get yourself movin' and get me some taillasher eggs. I'll need at least three of them if I'm going to have enough for tomorrow's meal.

The Bloodtalon taillashers can be fierce, and protect their eggs to the death more often than not. They sometimes bury their eggs too deep in the earth to uncover safely, but if you head to the Echo Isles to the southeast of Sen'jin Village, you can usually find them all over those islands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You might be weak, but at least you're not clumsy, friend.
Here, take this and get outta my way. I've got cooking to do.
